subject: adding text from 1 dataset to histogram of 2nd dataset

messages.author: 08d152204ff05b5c
messages.subject: adding text from 1 dataset to histogram of 2nd dataset
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to label the median of a series of histograms using two
different datasets. If I use the below code, it prints all of the
labels on the histogram when I would like it to only print the median
of the ids I am showing. The 2nd dataset is a subset of the first.

medians <- ddply(sept22_2011, .(id), summarise, med.x = median(FL1.H))

b <- ggplot(d155test, aes(x= FL1.H)) + geom_histogram(aes(x = FL1.H,
y = ..density..,fill = id), binwidth = .05, alpha = 0.5, position =
"identity") + geom_density(fill = 0, aes(linetype = id)) +
scale_x_log10(expand = c(0,0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
geom_text(data = medians, aes(x = med.x, y = .2, label = round(med.x,
digits = 2)))

I know that I can just use the 2nd dataset to get the correct plot,
but I would like to know if it is possible not to have to run the
medians code for each subset

This is what I would like it to look like:
medians <- ddply(d155test, .(id), summarise, med.x = median(FL1.H))
b <- ggplot(d155test, aes(x= FL1.H)) + geom_histogram(aes(x = FL1.H,
y = ..density..,fill = id), binwidth = .05, alpha = 0.5, position =
"identity") + geom_density(fill = 0, aes(linetype = id)) +
scale_x_log10(expand = c(0,0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
geom_text(data = medians, aes(x = med.x, y = .2, label = round(med.x,
digits = 2)))

Here is a link to the dput of the sept22 ddply medians data set
http://dl.dropbox.com/u/24951229/medians
Link to d155test file http://dl.dropbox.com/u/24951229/d155t

Thanks,
Chandra
